_comment: Machine-readable statement of what this project HAS and HAS NOT demonstrated. Updated in the same commit as any change to the claim state. Pattern credited to Vishwateja-123/hiver-support-agent (MIT); content and implementation are our own. See docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md.

tests._note: 3 skipped are superseded candidate-state taxonomy tests, retained and marked rather than deleted. 19 real-data tests skip without the corpus.

dataset.note: Reconstruction code was written against the DOCUMENTED TWCS schema. Those assumptions are unverified and may require changes once the real file is inspected.
dataset.brand_decision_status: Corrected re-decision 2026-09-10 after the reply_classify defect. Lexicographic tie-break, criterion 1 (usable_grounding_evidence_pairs 31,241 vs 20,076). Original decision preserved as superseded.

system.classifier_model: tfidf_logreg (chosen on operational grounds, not dev score)

evaluation.classifier_dev_labels: WEAK SUPERVISION - rule-recovery scores, NOT accuracy
evaluation._metric_note: No metric of real classification quality exists. Dev figures measure agreement with deterministic labelling functions that also produced the training labels, and manual inspection found the labeller wrong on real cases. True accuracy is unknown until the hand-labelled golden set exists.

llm.note: The entire deterministic pipeline is being built before any paid call. See DECISION_LOG.md D13.

ideas_adopted_with_citation: blind annotation subset to measure anchoring bias (AshrafAhmed9)
golden ids excluded from retrieval corpus (ChetanChavan45)

honest_summary: Corpus validated; AppleSupport selected by corrected re-decision; taxonomy FROZEN at v0.3.0. A classifier subsystem now exists (contract, weak-supervision labels, two baselines, an embedding candidate, independent security and context detectors, calibration and dev disagreement analysis). Its dev figures are RULE-RECOVERY SCORES against heuristics that manual inspection showed to be wrong on real cases - not accuracy. No golden set, no retrieval, no generation, no judge, no evaluation of system quality. Zero LLM API calls.

milestone.completed: 4 - classifier subsystem built and evaluated on dev against weak labels
milestone.next: hand-labelled golden set from the held-out test pool - the blocking dependency for any honest metric
milestone.model_training_note: TF-IDF + LogReg fitted on WEAK labels only; no human-labelled training data exists

brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.status: RESOLVED 2026-09-10 by approved lexicographic tie-break; AppleSupport re-decided on corrected evidence. Original preserved as superseded historical evidence.
brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.what_happened: Two defects were fixed in reply_classify: stem-only verb patterns missed inflected forms ('restarting'), and the English gate rejected terse navigation instructions, systematically discarding the most actionable replies.
brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.impact: Re-running the brand analysis raises actionable_resolution_rate by ~0.092 on average and usable_grounding_evidence_pairs by ~1487 per brand. Brands passing the pre-registered filters rise from 5 to 27. AmazonHelp and AppleSupport then tie at rubric score 0.7246 (exact to 6dp); the current winner is decided by sort order.
brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.action_taken: Frozen decision (AppleSupport) left UNCHANGED in brand_profiles.json / brand_decision.json / brand_selection.md. New evidence preserved separately as reports/brand_profiles_reclassified.json and brand_decision_reclassified.json.
brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.decision_required: Keep AppleSupport, switch to AmazonHelp, or add a principled tiebreak.
